title: Audit Your Local Competitor Gap in 5 Minutes
prompt: Act as a local search analyst. Compare my business ([Business Name], [City], [Primary Service]) against the top 3 competitors listed on Google Maps for [Target Keyword]. Build a 4-column table showing: (1) missing service pages on my site, (2) questions buyers ask that we do not answer directly, (3) review count gap, and (4) the single fastest fix to execute this week.
